purpose: Requirements for doc-link index scope (ToC key and index target specification), Markdown frontmatter document ID format, document ID issuance, validation and duplicate handling, and DLID resolution.
summary: Index target scope: ToC identification key, complete desired state per key, and target specification options (paths, dirs, exclude, all)
Fixed exclusion directories applied to --all scans and --dirs expansion, and rejection of ambiguous or reserved-key input
Independence of document ID from ToC keys and from Forge .doc_structure.yaml responsibility boundary
Document ID format in frontmatter doc_link_id: DLID- prefix plus 12-character Crockford Base32 value from 60-bit random
Index target list determination stage before ID checking (FR-017)
Document ID validation (FR-002): missing, malformed, duplicate document IDs and section IDs, treated uniformly as missing
DLID assignment operation (section 9.2): explicit invocation, issuing document IDs and section IDs, duplicate original resolution
Document ID confirmation step (9.1) excluding ID-less and duplicate documents from the ToC while reporting them
DLID resolution (FR-018): current path, heading and anchor, recorded content hash, no-record and path-missing responses
Acceptance conditions AC-005 to AC-031 covering duplicates, immutability, key independence, and resolution
tasks: Designing or implementing index target specification parsing (--key, --dirs, --paths, --exclude, --all)
Implementing document ID validation and duplicate detection
Implementing DLID resolution to current paths
Implementing the document ID confirmation stage of ToC building
Writing or reviewing acceptance tests for document ID behavior
Integrating doc-link with Forge via ToC identification keys
Reviewing design documents against document ID requirements
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — Index 対象と[文書 ID]
